title: How fast the sea surface has warmed since 1993
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine how fast the sea surface has warmed since 1993, where and in which seasons the warming is fastest, whether it is a steady trend or decadal variability, and what the spatial pattern suggests about its cause.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
